name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 5 visits over 38 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 38 hours starting 2025-05-20, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 3.77 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
